title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).   We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention lay

translated_title: Octopus：一个大脑，众多分支——面向潜在KV多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统通过生成具有隔离上下文窗口的子智能体来并行探索，而单智能体系统则将每次搜索和验证步骤追加到一条不断增长的轨迹中。然而，现有多智能体框架会在各分支间重复复制前缀KV缓存，通过重新预填充文本摘要来交换发现结果，并在强化学习（RL）过程中将跨分支依赖关系扁平化或丢弃。我们提出了Octopus，这是一个单模型多智能体强化学习框架，其中所有线程共享同一个主干网络，并通过五个原语（fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit）在驻留于GPU的有向无环图（DAG）KV状态上进行协调。Octopus结合了三个协同设计的机制：(1) 零拷贝基数分叉，将分支生成为共享物理KV页面上的O(1)复杂度游标视图；(2) 仅注意力KV挂载，将同级线程的末端KV块直接挂载到全注意力层中……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Octopus提出了一种单模型多智能体强化学习框架，让所有分支共享同一主干网络，并通过零拷贝基数分叉、仅注意力KV挂载等协同设计机制，在GPU驻留的KV状态有向无环图上进行高效协调，从而消除KV缓存重复复制和跨分支依赖丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: Octopus is a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all branches share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident DAG of KV states via zero-copy radix forking and attention-only KV mounting, eliminating duplicated KV caches and lost cross-branch dependencies.
